fn divide(p_a: i64, p_b: i64) -> Result<i64, String> {
    if p_b == 0 {
        return Err(String::from("division by zero"));
    }
    Ok(faber::exact::store::<i64>(faber::exact::div(p_a as i128, p_b as i128), "return"))
}

}
